mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized > 2.5%) signals an 'unpleasant trade-off' where central bank policy is constrained, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% with a 3-month increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and 3-month UNRATE change > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing construction starts (HOUST > 2100 units) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 2100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in economic output, reducing corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO 3-month decline > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high housing starts (HOUST > 2100) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000 million dollars) signal robust consumer spending, driving positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 2100 and RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
